ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, what happens if all pondweed are removed from the web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, Pondweed is located at the lower left, and Mayfly nymph is located above it and toward the left. A green arrow can be seen pointing upward from Pondweed to Mayfly nymph, indicating that pondweed is a food source for mayfly nymph. Reasoning: If all pondweed is removed from the food web, Mayfly nymph will lose this food source; a reduction in food will cause the number of consumers to decrease. Therefore mayfly nymph will decrease.
